session_cue.text: Drop Dead Ned's baseball-sized blood-red wasp inside Sir Alfred's ribs

previous.text: Drop Dead Ned's blood-red wasp made Sir Alfred tear himself apart, and the party left him undestroyed.
The party took Sir Brandon's magic sword from the barrow, and Vivian advised knocking the dragon out with faun wine.
Wayman persuaded four goblins to settle the Barrow Mound's upper rooms and promised to hide them from King Hogboon.
Dr. Uriah promised Brother Dirk to return the barrow robes to the church after the dragon is defeated.
Dr. Uriah began reading the map's labels, revealing the Dragon's Lair and the Dwarven mine.
Cedric signed a promissory note for the barrow treasure, and the party used it to recruit Malzazarik and Lady Hilda.
Warwick lent the party his mithril shirt and took Sir Phidipaldi's lyre and the plate armor as collateral.
Ingrid led the party to Vivian, the witch of the wood, who had nothing against the dragon's venom.
Grimny's ghost told Dunk which of his six brothers he believes killed him.
Dunk's ring let him speak with Grimny's ghost, who ascended after reading Vivian's letter.

current.where_you_are: The party stands at the caved-in entrance of the Dwarven mine, beside the burnt cabin.

Your goals.text: Find the treasure marked on the party's map.
Kill the dragon near Brandonsford for Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold bounty.
Get protection against the poison George the Hunter reported, before facing the dragon.

Standing in your way.text: A cave-in seals the Dwarven mine's entrance, blocking the party from getting Warwick's metal. It looks natural and can be dug through.
George says nothing pierces the black dragon's scales. Arrows and swords have all failed against them.
Cedric cannot pay the promissory note until the caravans flow again.

What could help.text: The party holds Sir Brandon's magic sword, which is especially effective against evil beings.
The party already has enough faun wine. Vivian says it could knock the dragon out so they can drag Sir Brandon's sword through its mouth, if they can reach it.
The wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda have joined the party against the dragon.
The party's map marks the Dragon's Lair. Grimny says it is a very small one-room cave the dwarves scouted several times and found empty.
Grimny says his brother Bral probably hid the dwarves' mine hoard in the Dragon's Lair. The party believes Bral is the dwarf who lost them the map in a bet.
Cedric's promissory note will pay the party 975 gold, three-quarters price for the barrow treasure, once the caravans flow again. The party has offered it to pay its new hirelings.
Sir Phidipaldi proposes leaving faun-wine-dosed game outside the dragon's cave, then going in once the dragon has eaten it.
Wayman wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt on loan. It greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells.

Still unanswered.text: Is there really a dragon, or is Bral only pretending there is one to keep everybody away, as Dunk suspects?
Grimny's ghost believes Bral, the greediest of the seven dwarf brothers, killed him. Did Bral really kill Grimny, and how?
Vivian says only Sir Brandon told his tale, and the church knows it. What did he really do against the dragon?
What became of Grimny's other brothers, Grelli, Durney, Brenny, Tedry, Rooney and Bral?
Dunk felt a growing urge to wear the dead dwarf's magic ring, and Dr. Uriah's witch powder couldn't tell. Is the ring cursed?

Promises and debts.text: The party must bring Warwick metal from the Dwarven mine. Until then he holds Sir Phidipaldi's lyre and the party's plate armor as collateral.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, lent for the mine trip. Ingrid says it was his grandfather's armor.
The party owes Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment for joining, offered out of Cedric's promissory note.
Dr. Uriah must do penance at the Barrow Mound for Father William.
Dr. Uriah must return the barrow robes to Brother Dirk's church once the dragon is defeated. The robes are not magical, just a religious relic.

Meanwhile.text: George says the black dragon will soon fly and doom Brandonsford.
With Wayman's encouragement, the goblins settling the Barrow Mound's upper rooms have declared destroying its church their first job as a free state.
Sir Alfred lies broken apart but not destroyed in the Barrow Mound's lower level. He may rise again and kill anyone in the mound, including the Free Goblin Society members staying there.

threads.name: Treasure map
threads.note: Dr. Uriah can now read the map's labels, the map's source is identified as Bral, and Grimny says the treasure is probably hidden at the Dragon's Lair (beat_77), which partly answers where it is. The treasure is not yet found.

threads.name: Dragon hunt (Eric the Reeve's bounty)
threads.note: Vivian's faun-wine method gives a way past the impenetrable scales (beat_48, beat_50), and Lady Hilda and Malzazarik joined (beat_62). Dunk now suspects there may be no dragon at all (beat_78). The dragon is still not killed.

threads.name: The goblins' bargain
threads.note: Wayman renegotiated with the same goblins. They will stay in the upper rooms behind walled-off stairs instead of having the mound cleared (beat_13). The party now owes Snurk silence toward King Hogboon (beat_15).

threads.name: Sir Alfred, the undead in the Barrow Mound
threads.note: Sir Alfred was incapacitated but not destroyed, and the party left him in the mound (beat_7, beat_10), so the danger has changed in nature but not ended. Brother Dirk calls him holy (beat_9).

threads.name: Missing shipments
threads.note: Cedric and Warwick both say supplies stopped when the dragon troubles began, which partly answers why the shipments stopped.

threads.name: Ingrid and Warwick (Dunk's deal)
threads.note: Ingrid's night visits to Warwick were confirmed, and Sir Phidipaldi told her Warwick is not interested (beat_58), which changes the situation. Dunk's promise to help her was never released, so the thread stays open.

threads.name: Dr. Uriah's penance for Father William
threads.note: Dr. Uriah did neither the penance nor the donation. The goblins now intend to destroy the Barrow Mound church (beat_14), which bears on the upkeep he owes.

threads.name: Squints' share of the treasure
threads.note: The party took a lot of treasure and signed it over to Cedric (beat_26) without giving Squints a pick. The promise is still owed.

threads.name: Robes for Brother Dirk
threads.note: Dr. Uriah promised to return the barrow robes to the church once the dragon is defeated (beat_23), and that promise is still owed. The promise is to Dirk's church, not a means of the hunt.

threads.name: Cedric's promissory note
threads.note: Cedric owes 975 gold for the treasure once the caravans flow again, and the note has been offered to pay the new hirelings. One deal with one counterpart.

threads.name: The Warwick deal
threads.note: The party owes Warwick metal from the Dwarven mine and the return of his mithril shirt, and Warwick holds the lyre and plate armor as collateral. These are sides of one bargain. The shirt was wanted for the mine, not the dragon, so the thread has no parent.

threads.name: Protection against the dragon's poison
threads.note: Sir Phidipaldi said anti-poison remedies are needed because they are hunting the dragon (beat_37), which makes this a child of the hunt. Neither Ingrid nor Vivian could provide any (beat_51).

threads.name: Vivian's message to Grimny
threads.note: Dunk delivered Vivian's scent and letter to Grimny's ghost, who then ascended (beat_79, beat_81). Nothing remains owed.

threads.name: Who killed Grimny
threads.note: Grimny believes his brother Bral killed him (beat_72), but this is unconfirmed. The fate of the other dwarves is also unknown. The question stands apart from the treasure hunt's aim.

threads.name: Grimny's ring
threads.note: Dunk wears a magical ring that drew him to put it on, and no one knows whether it is cursed (beat_69, beat_70). Its known power to reach Grimny's ghost is now moot because the ghost has gone.

facts.text: Find the treasure marked on the party's map.

Dr. Uriah can read the label under one location on the treasure map per day. One marked location is still unread; Sir Phidipaldi guesses it is King Hogboon's.
Kill the dragon near Brandonsford for Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold bounty.
George says nothing pierces the black dragon's scales; arrows and swords have all failed against them.
George says the black dragon will soon fly and doom Brandonsford.
Lady Hilda will join the party against the dragon if they pay her.
facts.ended_how: used up: Lady Hilda joined the party, recruited with Cedric's promissory note

facts.text: Warwick keeps a magical mithril chain shirt; Dunk says it could help against the dragon.
facts.ended_how: used up: Warwick lent the shirt and Wayman now wears it, held under the Warwick deal

facts.text: Where did the new dragon near Brandonsford come from?
The party holds Sir Brandon's magic sword, which is especially effective against evil beings.

Vivian says enough faun wine would knock the dragon out, letting them drag Sir Brandon's sword through its mouth as he did; they must reach its mouth, and dragons move around a lot. The party already has enough faun wine.
Sir Phidipaldi's plan: catch game, dose it with faun wine, leave it outside the dragon's cave and go in once the dragon has eaten it.
The wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda have joined the party against the dragon.
The party's treasure map marks the Dragon's Lair; Grimny says it is a very small cave, just one big room, that the dwarves scouted several times and found empty.
Is there really a dragon, or, as Dunk speculates, is Bral pretending there is one to keep everybody away?
Vivian says Sir Brandon's tale is told only by himself and the church knows it. What did Sir Brandon really do against the dragon?
Clear the evil out of the Barrow Mound for the Free Goblin Society.
facts.ended_how: replaced: Wayman renegotiated, and the goblins agreed to stay in the church, antechamber and statue room behind walled-off stairs instead of having the mound cleared (beat_13)

facts.text: A huge undead with a greatsword in the Barrow Mound stands in the way (see thread_4).
facts.ended_how: no longer relevant: the bargain no longer requires clearing the mound, and the goblins will wall off the stairs to Sir Alfred instead

facts.text: Wayman promised Snurk the Walkout never to tell King Hogboon where the Free Goblin Society goblins are living, if he ever sees him.
The goblins settling in the Barrow Mound's upper rooms, encouraged by Wayman, have declared destroying the mound's church their first job as a free state.

Sir Alfred, the seven-foot undead knight with a great sword, lies broken apart and incapacitated but not destroyed in the Barrow Mound's lower level. He may rise again and kill anyone in the mound, including the Free Goblin Society members who are staying there.
The undead may kill more Free Goblin Society members in the Barrow Mound.
facts.ended_how: replaced by fact_10: Sir Alfred is now incapacitated, and the danger to the goblins is covered there

facts.text: Why does Sir Alfred, an undead knight that Brother Dirk regards as holy, roam the Barrow Mound?
Cedric says his supply shipments have not come in since the troubles with the dragon began. What exactly is stopping shipments from reaching Brandonsford?
Will the caravans to Brandonsford flow again? Cedric's payment on his promissory note depends on it.
Why are hidden fairies coming out more often along with the dragon?
Who does the noblewoman statue in the Barrow Mound depict?
Dunk must help Ingrid get into Warwick's house and give Warwick the sleeping potion.
facts.possibly_moot: Sir Phidipaldi told Ingrid that Warwick knows of her night visits and is not interested, and she left crestfallen (beat_58, beat_60); Ingrid never released Dunk.

facts.text: Dr. Uriah must do penance at the Barrow Mound for Father William.
Dr. Uriah must give Father William a 10 gold donation for the Barrow Mound's upkeep.
facts.possibly_moot: The goblins now settling in the Barrow Mound declared destroying its church their first job (beat_14); Father William never released the donation.

facts.text: The party must let Squints pick second from the first treasure, after the elite members.
facts.possibly_moot: The party's first treasure from the barrow (beat_16) was signed over to Cedric for a promissory note (beat_26) without Squints picking; Squints never released the party.

facts.text: Dr. Uriah owes Brother Dirk's church the robes taken from the Barrow Mound, to be returned once the dragon is defeated; he keeps them meanwhile in case they help against it. Witch powder showed the robes are not magical, just a religious relic.

Cedric signed a promissory note to pay the party 975 gold for the barrow treasure, at three-quarters price, once the caravans flow again. The party has offered the note as payment to its new hirelings.
The party owes the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment for joining, offered out of Cedric's promissory note.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never stated the hirelings' share, terms, or whether the note itself was handed over.

facts.text: Cedric cannot pay the note until the caravans flow again.

The party must bring Warwick metal from the Dwarven mine, which he needs because he has had none since the dragon appeared. Warwick holds Sir Phidipaldi's lyre and the party's plate armor as collateral until then.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, lent for the trip to the Dwarven mine. Ingrid says it was his grandfather's armor and he never let her touch it.
Wayman wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan, over his leather armor. It greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells.
A cave-in seals the Dwarven mine's entrance, blocking the party from getting Warwick's metal. It looks natural and can be dug through; Dunk has already uncovered a dead dwarf in it.
Obtain protection against the dragon's poison, which George the Hunter reported, before facing the dragon.
Ingrid says protection against the dragon's poison is powerful magic beyond her, and Vivian offered nothing against it. Who can provide it?
Grimny's ghost believes his brother Bral, the greediest of the seven dwarf brothers, killed him. Did Bral really kill Grimny, and how?
What became of Grimny's other brothers, Grelli, Durney, Brenny, Tedry, Rooney and Bral, given the mine's burnt cabin and sealed entrance?

Dunk wears a magical ring taken from a dead dwarf's hand in the Dwarven mine cave-in, which he felt a growing urge to put on; Dr. Uriah's witch powder could not tell whether it is cursed. Is the ring cursed?
